Results.ReviewText:
This is my first Weber grill ever.  I've always wanted one and I got this one as a Father's day gift.

I have to say that I REALLY love it.  The grill itself is solid and doesn't have that flimsy metal twisting feel when you open the lid.  All the knobs are tight and I am very impressed on how the ignition system is wired.  

The battery compartment is inside the cabinet rather than directly behind the ignition button (which is usually more exposed to elements).  I'm looking forward to seeing how this configuration works and if it will mean reliable grill starts for more than a 4 month stretch before it quits.

The heating is completely even across the total cooking surface; no hot or cool "spots" to worry about.  I also think that this little 3 burner grill is much hotter than the 4 burner grill it replaced.  I was able to crank out a LOAD of food during our 4th of July cookout, much more efficiently than if I were cooking with my old 4 burner.

I'm super impressed and am looking forward to many years of cooking and ownership.
Results.Title: 3 burner that out performs my old 4 burner

Results.ReviewText: This is the second Spirit 310 I have owned. I gave my original one, which was about 10 years old to my son. It was still working great and he greatly enjoys its  convenience and the grilling results he is getting. I liked my original grill so much, I got another one for our new home. It is fantastic. It is easy to use and continues to deliver excellent results. It is weather resistent. I highly recommend it.
Results.Title: My new 310 is as great as my original 310.

Results.ReviewText: Along time ago I had a grill that used lava rocks (it was the best). For the past 20yeard I have tried several other brand and they were all rubbish. Then I use this one over at a friend's and I new I had finally found my new grill (like an old friend).

Results.ReviewText: Would not start when I brought it home call customer service decided it was a bad regulator hose customer service sent me a new one and now it works fine

Results.ReviewText: I’m a  Weber girl and had the full-size Genesis ..which lasted 12 great years. Decided to downsize and am just as happy. Grills have come a long way in so many years…this one works perfectly for me and still has PLENTY of cooking area.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill.   Enjoy cooking on the Spirit E-310 Gas Grill.  Our last Weber grill lasted 15 years.  Weber makes a great product.

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill! Easy heat control and accurate thermometer. Love that the bottom pan in fire box comes out for cleaning.

Results.ReviewText:
Only had this a couple of weeks and has exceeded expectations. Not one failure and has promoted me to be more creative when cooking. The temp guage is bang on which really helps if you're trying to smoke or slow cook anything.
More than pleased with my purchase.
Results.Title: Replaced an old friend

Results.ReviewText: I am loving my Weber!  We purchased the floor model a few weeks ago. It was the last one at the store.  We were prepared to take one home in the box; but the price was right!  The only thing is the starter does not work :(     We think the wires may have got switched and hope for an easy fix. I used the grill a handful of times. The grill heats up great!  It cleans easy and the heavy nonstick racks are great! Especially with boneless, skinless chicken. I am curious how it is going to handle grilled pizza!  I also love the 4 castors.  I really don't like the grills with only two.  We purchased a HIGH Temperature Grill Cover – Silicone Coated, Heavy Weight, All-Weathered, Waterproof, UV Resistant to protect it from the elements.  Now my Weber is very happy and so are we.
Results.Title: I love my Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Good grill. I like the tank gage and the grease system. Runs hot, still learning how to keep a steady 400 degrees.

Results.ReviewText: I would recommend the E-310 as I bought one for the lake house 2 years ago and liked it so I bought another for home.  Gave my Genesis to my youngest daughter.

Results.ReviewText: Order via their web site. Weber kept me informed of the shipping - delivered on time. They registered my warranty info.  Used it the first time and found that I am a great cook! All the other meals on lesser grills made me look like a terrible cook.

Results.ReviewText: Super easy to use and clean.  Cooks very evenly and has a solid build and structure.  So glad I got it.  I appreciate the under the grill cabinet too.

Results.ReviewText: Love Weber Grill.  Only reason for 4 rating is that I liked the drop down shelves that were on my previous Weber.    The drop shelves made storage easier.

Results.ReviewText:
Overall good but the gas tank regulator can be a real pain. Sometimes when it’s turned on there is no gas pressure due to the regulator. Other times it’s fine. I know it’s supposed to be a safety device but it’s mostly a negative for most people who know how to use a grill properly. Also there is less 
Heat on high than I would like for a grill like this. Get rid or revise the regulator .

Results.Title: Weber Spirit

Results.ReviewText: Well constructed machine! Pretty easy to put together.
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Nice but not nearly as beefy as my last Weber gas grill. I may have purchased up but I did not want or need the sear system (gimmicky).  Something that irks me is the Weber logo emblem is crooked on the front. I've see this on other of their grills as well. Pretty bad corporate image.
Results.Title: Nice but flimsy

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill to replace a 20 year old Genesis Silver B that finally but the dust only because of the frame. I loved it. A new Weber was a no brainer for me. It took me awhile to put together my new Spirit E315 but the instructions were excellent. The parts were packaged well with precisely the correct number of connectors. I plan for this one to last another 20 years. Perhaps the best thing about Weber is their customer service. They will have parts for my grill even 20 years from now. Thanks, Weber.
Results.Title: Weber quality and great customer service

Results.ReviewText: So far the grill has been excellent.  After some heavy use on the 4th of July I will now need to do my first major cleaning.
Results.Title: Pleased so far!!!

Results.ReviewText: A great grill.  Replaced my other grill easy to use and cleans up easily.  Fits on deck well.
Results.Title: New Weber Spirit E 310. Large space and easy clean

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
